description: SIMCom modules (USB 1e0e): SIM7100/SIM7600 (with profiles of their own for 9001, 9003, 9011), SIM7906, SIM8200/SIM8202 and A7600; serial ports on option, data over QMI, MBIM, ECM or RNDIS by the module's USB PID setting. ModemManager owns them (its simtech plugin). Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: ModemManager src/plugins/simtech, the imported catalog (10 IDs), another modem manager modem/usb list 3.9.43; the owner, 2026-11-13

radio.source: the family's AT set as the model profile simcom-sim7600-9001 documents it (its sources there); under ModemManager the radio is read and set through ModemManager's own plugin, the dialect is for an AT port the engine holds itself
